scope: Evidence inventory, not an executable result schema or global qualification score

capabilities.implementation: Native fit_pca/FlexiblePCA and browser full-X PCA diagnostics
capabilities.numerical_provider: Methods 1.3.13 / ABI 2.20 through public native or Preflight callback APIs
capabilities.protocol: browser_x.v1; native train-only/full-source protocols retain their distinct scope
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline Windows/Ubuntu gates, 4 common native/WASM fixtures, direct WASM analytical eigenvalues 1 and 4 at 1e-12; stricter common-checker replay uses exact original fixture bytes
capabilities.limits: Browser retains at most 20 resolved components; full moments are provider outputs, never inferred from truncated eigenvalues. Native FlexiblePCA may lack exact squared moments.
capabilities.missing_evidence: Independent general-spectrum oracle, tied eigenspaces, >20-component moment/truncation and difficult-conditioning fixtures

qualification.numerical: tested finite fixtures and transport consistency
qualification.scientific: descriptive variance, not causal chemistry or external prediction

capabilities.implementation: Native raw/SNV geometry/continuity and browser raw PCA score geometry
capabilities.numerical_provider: Methods PCA, summaries and distance primitives
capabilities.protocol: Native structure protocols; bounded descriptive browser_x.v1
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline native integration and browser score/schema tests; public complete-population synthetic smoke
capabilities.limits: Geometry depends on representation, axes and population; displayed components are not full-space distances
capabilities.missing_evidence: General interpretation of continuous factors and small-population uncertainty; independent study validation

qualification.scientific: observed structure only; no intrinsic good/bad dataset label

capabilities.implementation: Native neighbors/support; browser exact full-reference raw/resolved-score queries with self or declared-group exclusion
capabilities.protocol: browser_x.v1 fixes k=min(8,n-1); historical overlap is intersection/k in its declared query scope
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline 1D distance and same-group/no-reference cases; added malformed ordering/padding adversaries exercise current PR CI
capabilities.limits: Browser exports first-neighbor distance summaries, not independent physical support. Historical query sampling differs from browser complete queries.
capabilities.missing_evidence: Independent per-observation distance oracle over broader shapes and matched representation sensitivity

qualification.numerical: exact owner kernel on tested fixtures
qualification.scientific: proximity under stated exclusions, not identity, leakage or Jaccard by default

capabilities.implementation: Native HDBSCAN/hierarchy and selected-branch persistence; browser one fixed resolved-score HDBSCAN fit
capabilities.numerical_provider: Methods HDBSCAN EOM and summary APIs
capabilities.protocol: browser EOM min_cluster_size=8/min_samples=4, allow_single_cluster=false; selected_branch_persistence.v1 is one-fit evidence
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline two-population, small-population and all-noise/degenerate state tests; label-invariant platform parity
capabilities.limits: Persistence/membership describe one fit. Rows are not automatically independent units. Browser has no parameter search or hierarchy comparison.
capabilities.missing_evidence: Resampling, parameter/preprocessing robustness and physical corroboration for a new population

qualification.software: one fit live; native hierarchy is broader
qualification.scientific: exploratory density; no risk probability, causal batch or stability certificate

capabilities.implementation: Native non-Y factor associations and saved D1 factor reading; no live browser metadata-factor protocol
capabilities.protocol: Exact source/membership binding and D1/D2 conditional deployment relevance
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline association-transport, semantic/source binding and intended-use companion contracts; no new association fit
capabilities.limits: Association is not causation; a categorical factor alone does not scientifically require LOGO. Crossed factors need not form a tree.
capabilities.missing_evidence: Original memberships, physical/context meaning and an appropriate independent confirmation contrast

qualification.scientific: conditional corroboration, not a shortcut mechanism

capabilities.implementation: Identity/exclusion guards and documentary dependency interpretation
capabilities.numerical_provider: IO/Datasets declared identities; Methods/Preflight/DAG operations only where admitted
capabilities.protocol: Preserve acquisitions/specimens/reference units and whole connected dependencies; never infer them from spectra or row position
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline duplicate/group/source-binding/leakage adversaries and physical-identity fabrication refusal
capabilities.limits: D1 corpus carries no complete physical/reference roster; missing transported metadata does not prove original-source absence
capabilities.missing_evidence: Verified physical/assay crosswalk and effective experimental-unit denominator

qualification.scientific: dependency independence unavailable without original evidence

capabilities.implementation: Native and saved matched raw/preprocessed geometry/partition/neighbor comparisons
capabilities.numerical_provider: Methods preprocessing, PCA, neighbors and partition-agreement APIs
capabilities.protocol: Same source/content/population and compatible query/parameter scopes; D6.1 distinguishes parameter from representation comparisons
capabilities.executed_tests: Existing native/companion comparison contracts and frozen cartilage counterexample replay; no new preprocessing fit
capabilities.limits: High neighborhood overlap can coexist with low ARI. Browser has no qualified paired-representation protocol.
capabilities.missing_evidence: Prospective replication under fixed choices and independently qualified experimental units

qualification.scientific: sensitivity in stated representation; no winner or predictive consequence inferred

capabilities.implementation: Native train_refit_stability and historical bounded stability protocols; not live browser
capabilities.numerical_provider: Methods PCA/neighbors/clustering through existing native protocols
capabilities.protocol: Freeze resampling unit, coverage, settings and effective sample limitations separately from one-fit persistence
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline native ignored/integration gates and saved-state contracts; no fresh bootstrap or real-source stability experiment
capabilities.limits: Repeatability, parameter sensitivity, within-fit persistence and resampling answer different questions
capabilities.missing_evidence: Admitted resampling units and adequate replicate/uncertainty evidence for each intended population

qualification.software: native protocol available; live browser not qualified
qualification.scientific: no new robust-structure claim from this review

capabilities.implementation: Native fitted PCA/transform, train-reference distances and residuals; narrow saved PC1 evidence; browser full-X route refuses held-out inputs
capabilities.numerical_provider: Methods PCA/FlexiblePCA, transform, neighbors and summaries
capabilities.protocol: Existing native train-only scopes; proposed extension requires owner validation, no pooled-X fitting
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline native no-test-fit/retained-target invariance and FlexiblePCA tests; public IO test/predict refusal
capabilities.limits: PC1 range evidence is not multivariate support. Browser diagnostics do not expose reusable mean/loadings/fitted state.
capabilities.missing_evidence: Owner-approved browser fitted-state contract, adversarial projection/support qualification and source-specific units

qualification.software: native seam available; browser feature not implemented
qualification.numerical: existing native tested seam, not browser parity
qualification.scientific: observed-evaluation geometric support only; future guarantee unavailable

capabilities.implementation: D2 intended-use interpretation and scope-aware D3 saved comparison; no transfer estimator or automatic validation choice
capabilities.numerical_provider: Existing prediction/report owners; interpreter performs no fit
capabilities.protocol: Distinguish specimens, groups, instruments and entire studies; use the strongest defensible design for the stated objective
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline intent/unknown-use/unchanged-metric/crossed-factor contracts and public intent purity
capabilities.limits: Conventional CV or LOCO-X does not certify physically meaningful LOGO or unseen-study transfer
capabilities.missing_evidence: Admitted untouched populations, context/identity closure, independent units and adequate study replication

qualification.scientific: only the exact evaluated population/design; no generic transfer certification

capabilities.implementation: Read-only compatible prediction comparison, existing exploratory PLS/Ridge research, D5/D6/D6.1 documentary reading
capabilities.numerical_provider: Methods/DAG model/scoring owners for historical fits; Domains reads source-bound evidence
capabilities.protocol: Train-only choices, matched evaluations, baseline-skill-conditional degradation and separate independent warning review
capabilities.executed_tests: Baseline D3/D5/D6 contracts and saved replays; no new real-source fit or human judgment
capabilities.limits: R3c/R3d have too few external families, estimator-dependent signs and weak-baseline/discovery limitations. D5 18/20 scenarios are simulated, not user benefit.
capabilities.missing_evidence: Adequate independent measured-target confirmation, useful reference skill, uncertainty and genuine expert/user effectiveness evidence

qualification.software: saved comparison/reporting works; browser predictive fit unavailable
qualification.scientific: no calibrated structural failure probability or demonstrated practical utility
